title: Establish an identifiable baseline for later engineering reliance
actor: An engineer responsible for retaining an engineering state
goal: Establish a coherent identifiable state whose declared content and interpretation can be inspected later.
context: A body of engineering work is ready to be retained as a reference state while future work continues.
trigger: The engineer needs an identifiable Baseline for subsequent review, comparison, or recovery.
preconditions: The intended governed scope and its authoritative engineering material are identified.
The project's applicable interpretation rules and retention policy are available.

interaction.action: Identifies the state to retain, its declared scope, and included engineering material.
Presents the proposed Baseline identity, retained scope, applicable rules, provenance, and any missing or conflicting content.
Requests establishment of the coherent state within the applicable authority.
Reports the retained Baseline and its included content, or the exact scope that could not be established.

expected_outcome: The engineer can refer later participants to an identifiable retained Baseline whose original definitions, relationships, rules, and provenance remain distinguishable from later work.

alternatives.condition: Some supporting external material is referenced but is outside the retained scope.
alternatives.outcome: The Baseline distinguishes those references from content it can actually recover.

alternatives.condition: Realization or assurance material is included in the declared scope.
alternatives.outcome: The retained-state description identifies that material and its original basis with the engineering definitions.

failures.condition: Required authoritative content or applicable interpretation rules are unavailable or conflicting.
failures.outcome: The system identifies the gap and does not claim to have established a complete coherent Baseline.

failures.condition: Retention does not complete for all declared content.
failures.outcome: The system reports what was retained and what remains unconfirmed.

sources.basis: IR-003 owns this situation; SR-020 derives coherent Baseline identity, scope, preservation, interpretation, and provenance obligations. Accepted as current requirement-analysis knowledge after independent coverage and clarity review: one owning IR and primary Feature, observable goal and interactions, classified outcomes, and applicable SR coverage.
